notes.title: Update v1.0.7
notes.content:
📢 Hello friends,

We hope everyone had a good Christmas Eve! 🎉 
We have just released an update bundling the fixes and tweaks from the last few days.
Below are the details of update [b]v1.0.7[/b] :

FEATURE - Steam Cloud saving has been enabled for Mechanic Heroes (but more testing will be needed to make sure save sync works properly on supported platforms)

BUGFIX - Fixed a bug where the menu would become unresponsive after tabbing out and back in.
BUGFIX - Fixed a bug where HUD UI animations would not played until the end.
BUGFIX - "Flat Battery" popup can no longer appear after the end of the timer.
BUGFIX - Fixed a bug where unlocking a bronze piggy would not grant the access to the following level.
BUGFIX - Attempted to fix a bug where the wrong number of tools would be spawned.
BUGFIX - Fixed a UI bug where tutorial cards would be displayed in front of the pause menu.
BUGFIX - Level 2.2: collisions added + Croncrete bags can no longer damage the vehicles.
BUGFIX - Race 04: fixed collisions to prevent vehicle's wheels from passing under the ground.

TWEAK - "Quit" entry of the pause menu is disabled during Intro/Outro levels (because these levels must be completed to unlock the following ones).

LOCALIZATION - A number of Traditional Chinese translation mistakes were fixed in the menus.

Thank you all for your support!
Have fun!
The DevTeam

notes.title: Remote Play [BETA] and Demo Update
notes.content:
[h1]Remote Play Beta[/h1]

We are happy to announce that we enabled "Remote Play" on Mechanic Heroes. 
At the moment, we consider this feature to be in its beta stage, so don't hesitate to give feedback if you play the game (or the demo) with friends through "Remote Play".

[h1]Demo Update[/h1]

We've updated the demo to reflect the most recent changes made to the main game.

For those who decide to take the plunge and make Mechanic Heroes a permanent fixture in their gaming library, we have an 

[b]IMPORTANT NOTE[/b] : If you transition from the demo to the full game, it is [b][u]necessary to start a fresh save[/u][/b]. We appreciate your understanding.

Thank you for support,

Cheers and take care,

The Dev Team

notes.title: Mechanic Heroes is OUT!
notes.content:
Dear friends!

We were all set to launch our game tomorrow, but guess what? A crafty pirate swiped our trailer and sped off into the digital sunset... (Just to be clear, our tale of piracy has absolutely no link to the GTA 6 trailer uproar! Shhh... 🤫)

Anyway, drumroll! We're ecstatic to announce that Mechanic Heroes is now live on Steam!

We've poured our hearts and souls into creating this game. Despite our best efforts, a pesky bug or two might have slipped past us. So, if you stumble upon any, kindly lend us a hand by reporting them!

It's time to dive into the grease, rev those engines, and spread the word far and wide! Wishing you all an incredible gaming experience and a fantastic holiday season!

Cheers and take care,

The Mechanic Heroes Team

notes.title: Mechanic Heroes COMING SOON!
notes.content:
Dear Community,

📅 [b]Release Date[/b]:
We're thrilled to share a major update with you! We have been hard at work, and we're delighted to announce that our upcoming game is set to launch on December 14th, at the earliest. However, we want to be transparent with our community, and in the spirit of delivering the best possible game, we're reserving the right to adjust the release date if needed. Rest assured, we'll keep you informed as we approach the finish line, ensuring a polished and enjoyable gaming experience.

🌐 [b]Multilingual Experience[/b]:
We're excited to announce that Mechanic Heroes will be available in multiple languages at launch! Due to budget constraints, we had to turn to AI for translations. While we acknowledge that this may result in some imperfect translations, we're optimistic that it won't hinder your ability to enjoy the game. After the launch, we're planning to set up a community translation space where volunteers can contribute to improving the quality of translations. Your help and input will be invaluable in making Mechanic Heroes a truly global experience!

💲 [b]Pricing Details[/b]:
The game will be priced at $15.99 in the USA. For our international players, please refer to the Steam price charts for a more accurate pricing in your currency (https://steamdb.info/blog/valve-price-matrix-2022-update/#15-99-usd). We appreciate your understanding as we work to make Mechanic Heroes accessible to players around the world.

Thank you for your continued support, patience, and understanding. We can't wait to share this experience with you. Stay tuned for more updates as we get closer to the big day!

Happy gaming,
Elouarn and Julien

notes.title: Development Update 4
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We wanted to start this dev log by apologizing for not communicating much on the game development progress. As a small team of two, we've been concentrating our efforts on bringing [i]Mechanic Heroes[/i] to life. However, we're excited to share some key updates with you.

[h2]Current Progress
[/h2]
[h3]Level Design[/h3]
We're thrilled to share that 25 levels of our adventure are now playable. Most are near completion, but some still need that extra polish to shine.

[h3]Localization[/h3]
We're diligently working on localization to make the game accessible to a global audience. Due to resource constraints, some language options may need to be postponed until after the initial launch. Our primary focus is on delivering a polished game in the first release.

[h3]Playtesting[/h3]
Multiple internal playtests have been conducted to fine-tune the game's balance and overall enjoyability. This iterative process is crucial to ensure that [i]Mechanic Heroes[/i] offers a challenging yet rewarding experience.

[h3]Bug Fixing[/h3]
We're actively addressing numerous bugs, primarily affecting the online multiplayer experience. Our goal is to provide a seamless and fun co-op experience.

Our target remains the same - we're aiming for a full release of [i]Mechanic Heroes[/i] by the end of the year. We're fully invested in making this game an unforgettable experience for players, and we appreciate your patience and support as we work tirelessly to bring our vision to life. Stay tuned for more updates as we continue this exciting journey!

Cheers,
Elouarn and Julien

notes.title: Development Update 3 - Steam Next Fest 2023
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

This week is Steam Next Fest, so it was a good opportunity to update our Mechanic Heroes demo. In a nutshell, here's what's changed:
[list]
[*] The demo has benefited from improvements to the base game (bug fixes, performance...)
[*] We've introduced 4 new languages: French, German, Spanish and Portuguese. For these, we have used automatic translation services, if you want to help us improve the translations, feel free to join our Discord server :) 
[*] A new race track with a bit more chaos
[*] A video trailer to show you what's in the pipes (requires to finish the demo)
[/list]

NOTE: For the players that already have installed the game, it is recommended to create a new save to avoid potential bugs. 

We hope you'll enjoy the game and discover other cool demos :D 
Cheers

notes.title: Demo v0.2.2.3 Changelog
notes.content:
📢 Dear mechanics,

Last Sunday, we decided to upload our demo on [url=https://lategamestudios.itch.io/mechanic-heroes]Itch.io[/url]. 
It was also the occasion to update the game, here follows what's changed: 🐞 ⬇️

CHANGELOG (v0.2.2.3)
[b]Fixed[/b]
- Floor texture misalignment on first chapter
- Bugfixing on Assembly Line: right lane vehicle could be sent while left vehicle was not ready, with 3 players.
- Forced some textures to be loaded before level start (footstep smoke, Assembly Line decals)
- Fixed a rounding issue on High Score display (Level selection menu)
- Potential fix: lift could be raised when there was no vehicle on it.
- Potential fix: player could get into a vehicle while being lifted.
- Fix: game could not be played while logged out of Steam.
[b]Improvements[/b]
- Improved top left corner collisions on level "Lift Off". Ceiling collisions raised on 1st chapter levels.
- Vehicle collisions are changed to a generic box when the vehicle is on the lift (to facilitate movement around the vehicle).
- Interaction with bundled wheels are now consistent with other interactables. Bundled wheels cannot be picked up from outside the delivery truck.
- Bundled wheels drop orientation changed so that they can easily roll on the floor. Kick force increased on the bundled wheels.
[b]Balancing[/b]
- Score balance on the levels of the 1st chapter

Don't hesitate to join our [url=https://discord.gg/2RCgRkWwhd]Discord[/url] server to tell us what you think. 🙏 
Have a great day,
Late Game Studios
